implemented_zh: 已把 GHG Protocol 拆成 19 个细分系列/标准/指南/项目节点，并在图2、GHG 全屏图和标准角色族图中展示。
implemented_en: GHG Protocol has been split into fine-series standard, guidance, project-protocol, and program nodes and is shown in Figure 2, the GHG full-screen graph, and the standard role-family graph; current counts are injected from reporting_views.json and the authoritative exports.
remaining_zh: 显式证据仍不足：231 家 GHG 相关企业中只有 137 家显式命中具体系列；当前只有 267 条 accepted 细分边，454 条 12 类白名单内企业-系列边仍为 effective review；另有 19 条白名单外 GHG 衍生/泛化引用已隔离复核。其中 P1 样本缺少命名系列 169 条、P2 低证据上下文 285 条。不能把上下文映射当成强证据。
remaining_en: Explicit evidence remains insufficient: 137/231 GHG-related companies explicitly cite concrete series; only 267 fine-series edges are accepted, and 454 core-whitelist company-series edges remain effective review rows, and 19 out-of-whitelist GHG-derived/generic references are isolated for separate review. The open queue includes 169 P1 named-series-missing rows and 285 P2 low-evidence contextual rows. Contextual mappings must not be treated as strong evidence.
current_evidence_zh: 当前定义 12 个 GHG 细分系列，8 个有企业命中；231 家 GHG 企业中 137 家显式命中具体系列（59.3%）。映射审计 CSV 已列出 801 条企业-系列边，其中 65 条已从普通上下文映射隔离为 contextual_overmapped_review。全量过度映射降级账本已关闭 61 条错挂边；这些行仍保留在原始 CSV 中用于追溯，但其中 61 条已从显式证据补强队列有效开放量排除、16 条已从显式系列候选队列排除。当前有效开放的显式证据补强队列为 454 条；显式系列候选队列为 0 条，其中 0 条可能复核后升级、0 条可能需要重分配或降级；上下文过度映射复核队列当前有效开放 454 条，并拆成 P0 可能过度映射 0 条、P1 样本缺少命名系列 169 条、P2 低证据上下文 285 条。P0 过度映射降级账本已将 16 条当前错误边标记为降级，且替代命名系列已在 accepted mapping 中采信。
current_evidence_en: Current payload defines 12 GHG fine series; 8 have company hits. 137/231 GHG companies have explicit fine-series citations (59.3%). The mapping audit CSV lists 801 company-series edges, including 65 edges isolated from ordinary contextual mappings as contextual_overmapped_review. The full overmapping demotion ledger has closed 61 overmapped edges; those rows remain in raw CSVs for traceability, but 61 have been excluded from the effective-open explicit-evidence queue and 16 from the effective-open explicit-series candidate queue. The effective-open explicit-evidence queue now lists 454 edges; the explicit-series candidate queue lists 0 named-series candidates (0 possible promotions and 0 possible reassign/demote cases), and the contextual-overmapping queue lists 454 effective-open contextual edges split into 0 P0 possible overmappings, 169 P1 named-series-missing rows, and 285 P2 low-evidence contextual rows. The P0 overmapping demotion ledger now marks 16 current erroneous edges as demoted with their replacement named series already accepted.
next_action_zh: 逐条回到 PDF 页级证据，能显式命名具体 GHG 系列的升级；不能命名的降级或删除。
next_action_en: Return each edge to page-level PDF evidence; upgrade only edges that explicitly name a concrete GHG series, and demote or remove edges that do not.
blocking_risk_zh: 如果不降级上下文弱边，GHG 细分图会被误读为强证据企业-系列关系。
blocking_risk_en: If weak contextual edges are not demoted, the GHG fine-series graph will be misread as strong-evidence company-series relationships.

remaining_en: The relationship structure exists, but each edge still needs stronger page-level traceability, snippet completeness, and evidence-strength review.
current_evidence_zh: 当前标准角色图包含 32 个标准节点、339 家企业、1908 条标准-企业关系。
current_evidence_en: The standard role graph contains 32 standard nodes, 339 companies, and 1908 standard-company links. The relationship audit CSV lists 1908 standard-company edges.
next_action_zh: 抽样复核标准-企业边的页码与 snippet 完整度，优先处理低置信/弱片段。
next_action_en: Sample and review standard-company edge page numbers and snippet completeness, prioritizing low-confidence or weak-snippet edges.

blocking_risk_en: The structure is complete, but uneven edge evidence and weak snippets reduce knowledge-graph credibility.

implemented_zh: 已生成企业总排放强证据排行和静态 PNG；当前有 85 家企业可计算可用总量。
implemented_en: A strong-evidence total-emissions ranking and static PNG have been generated; 85 companies currently have available total-emissions values.
remaining_zh: 只有 21 家满足完整 Scope 1 + 选定 Scope 2 + Scope 3 强证据可比排行；64 家 partial 总量不能混成完整排行。Scope 1、Scope 2 方法/数值和 Scope 3 缺口仍需继续回到页级证据闭环。
remaining_en: Only 21 companies meet the complete Scope 1 + selected Scope 2 + Scope 3 strong-evidence comparable-ranking gate. The 64 partial totals must not be mixed into the complete ranking, and Scope 1, Scope 2 value/method, and Scope 3 gaps remain open.
current_evidence_zh: 当前有 85 家可用总量，21 家满足完整 Scope 1/2/3 强证据排行；排行图展示 21 家完整强证据企业。排行审计 CSV 已列出 85 家可用总量，并拆出完整排行 P2 复核 16 条、Scope 3 缺口 45 条、Scope 2 总缺口 50 条（其中 Scope 2 数值缺口 41 条、Scope 2 口径复核 9 条）、Scope 1 缺口 24 条、单位/表格列尺度复核 4 条。
current_evidence_en: Current data has 85 available totals, 21 complete Scope 1/2/3 strong-evidence rankings, and 21 companies in the ranking graph. The ranking audit CSV lists 85 available totals and separates 16 complete-ranking P2 verification rows, 45 Scope 3 gaps, 0 finance Scope 3 boundary reviews, 9 selected-row evidence-element reviews, 50 total Scope 2 gaps (41 missing-value rows and 9 method-review rows), 24 Scope 1 gaps, and 4 unit/table-column scale review rows.
next_action_zh: 按 Scope 1、Scope 2 方法/数值、Scope 3 缺口队列补齐完整强证据总量。
next_action_en: Backfill complete strong-evidence totals from the Scope 1, Scope 2 value/method, Scope 3, and finance Scope 3 boundary queues.
blocking_risk_zh: partial 总量若混入主排行，会导致企业总排放排序不可比。
blocking_risk_en: Mixing partial totals or unclear finance financed-emissions boundaries into the main ranking would make company total-emissions comparisons invalid.

implemented_zh: 50 个 full-graph HTML 已统一为内嵌 JSON；4 个 GHG/Standard 角色族页使用 reporting_views 同源裁剪 JSON，46 个旧 generic 页使用严格版本化 JSON 和共享 generic_full_graph.js。静态 fallback 和旧 inline runtime 已移除。
implemented_en: All 50 full-graph HTML pages now use embedded JSON. The 4 GHG/Standard role-family pages embed same-source reporting_views graph subsets, while 46 legacy generic pages use strict versioned JSON plus shared generic_full_graph.js. Static fallback and old inline runtime have been removed.
remaining_zh: 两个旧 principle 角色族页本身无可绘制节点，当前进入可见空数据状态；这属于数据空缺，不是运行时 fallback。
remaining_en: Two legacy principle role-family pages have no drawable nodes and now enter a visible empty-data state. This is a data gap, not a runtime fallback.
current_evidence_zh: 50 个全屏图页面已统一为内嵌 JSON：4 个 GHG/标准角色族页面嵌入 reporting_views.json 同源裁剪图谱，46 个旧 generic 页面嵌入严格版本化 JSON 并加载共享 generic_full_graph.js；企业节点使用行业颜色，标准/中层节点使用主题颜色，不再依赖旧 inline runtime 或运行时外部 fetch。
current_evidence_en: All 50 full-screen pages now use embedded JSON: the 4 GHG/standard role-family pages embed same-source reporting_views.json graph subsets, while 46 legacy generic pages embed strict versioned JSON and load the shared generic_full_graph.js renderer. Company nodes use industry colors, standard/middle nodes use theme colors, and the pages no longer depend on the old inline runtime or runtime external fetch.
next_action_zh: 后续每次改 reporting_views 或 full-graph 生成器后跑全量 HTML/PNG hash 校验。
next_action_en: After any reporting_views or full-graph generator update, rerun the full HTML and PNG hash consistency checks.
blocking_risk_zh: 当前是展示层风险；数据更新后未同步生成会重新漂移。
blocking_risk_en: This is now a presentation-layer risk only; future data updates can drift again if sync generation is skipped.

status_zh: 口径已实现，源文引用仍需复核
status_en: Policy implemented, source quotations still need review
implemented_zh: 页面和图谱已明确：只有 GHG Protocol 语境使用 Scope 1/2/3；非 GHG 标准默认使用直接/间接排放口径。非 GHG 标准自身名称/角色/原则中的 Scope 术语误用为 0 条。
implemented_en: Pages and graphs now state that Scope 1/2/3 terminology applies only under GHG Protocol context; non-GHG standards default to direct/indirect emissions wording. Non-GHG standard name/role/principle Scope-term misuse is currently zero.
remaining_zh: 仍有 74 条源文引用含 Scope 词，需要确认它们只作为原文证据展示，而没有被提升为非 GHG 标准自身术语。
remaining_en: Seventy-four source quotations still contain Scope wording and need review to confirm that they are quoted source context only, not non-GHG standard terminology.
current_evidence_zh: 报告页和全屏图的说明已明确该口径，standard_cluster_full_graph.js 对非 GHG 标准显示直接/间接口径提醒。当前非 GHG 标准自身名称/角色/原则中的 Scope 术语误用为 0 条；源文引用中出现 Scope 的 P2 复核为 74 条。
current_evidence_en: The reporting page and full-screen graph explicitly state this rule; standard_cluster_full_graph.js shows a direct/indirect wording reminder for non-GHG standards. Current non-GHG standard-name/role/principle Scope-term misuse rows: 0; source-quote Scope review rows: 74.
next_action_zh: 确认非 GHG 标准源文中的 Scope 词只作为引用展示，不进入标准自身术语。
next_action_en: Confirm that Scope wording in non-GHG source quotes remains source evidence display and is not promoted into ISO/GB/PCAF wording.
blocking_risk_zh: Scope 术语若进入非 GHG 标准口径，会造成标准体系概念错误。
blocking_risk_en: Promoting Scope terminology into non-GHG standards would create a conceptual error in the standards taxonomy.

status_zh: 展示完成，证据核验未完成
implemented_zh: 图6 已有 9 类技术路径、流程图、标准对齐、细分技术方向、时间信号和成本信号，并生成中英文静态 PNG。另有独立页级项目证据层：77 条有效项目/措施证据，覆盖 51 家企业，其中 12 条含成本/投资证据，67 条含减排效果证据。
implemented_en: Figure 6 now shows 9 technology paths with flow, standards alignment, subtypes, timeline signals, cost signals, and bilingual static PNGs. A separate page-level project-evidence layer contains 77 valid project/measure records across 51 companies, including 12 cost/investment records and 67 abatement-effect records. A project-upgrade queue now covers 303 disclosure-signal edges with priority counts {'P1': 227, 'P2': 76}.
remaining_zh: 独立项目证据层可作为页级项目/措施强证据使用，invalid 项目证据队列为 0 条。但旧的 303 条技术-企业关系仍是 disclosure keyword signal，不是已核证项目成本、实施进度或减排量；公司级证据、时间趋势和成本/投资复核队列仍需继续处理。
remaining_en: The separate project-evidence layer can be used as page-level project/measure evidence, with 0 invalid project-evidence rows. However, the legacy 303 technology-company rows remain disclosure keyword signals, not verified project cost, implementation progress, or abatement values. The project-upgrade queue marks missing project/measure name, page/source binding, implementation stage, timeline, cost/investment, and abatement-effect fields; no row allows automatic promotion.
current_evidence_zh: 当前有 9 类技术路径；9 类有细分方向，9 类有时间趋势，9 类有成本信号，并已生成中英文静态 PNG。技术路径审计 CSV 已列出 303 条技术-企业关系；总复核队列列出 303 条，并已拆成公司级证据补回 61 条、时间趋势核验 150 条、成本/投资信号核验 221 条。
current_evidence_en: Current data has 9 technology paths; 9 include subtypes, 9 include timeline counts, 9 include cost signals, and bilingual PNGs are generated. A separate page-level project-evidence layer now contains 77 valid records across 51 companies, with 0 invalid project-evidence rows. The legacy technology-path audit CSV still lists 303 disclosure-signal technology-company rows; the total validation queue lists 303 rows and is split into 61 company-evidence backfills, 150 timeline validations, and 221 cost/investment validations.
next_action_zh: 把关键词信号升级到公司级项目证据，补时间节点和成本/投资证据边界。
next_action_en: Upgrade keyword hits to company-level project evidence, then validate timeline milestones and cost/investment evidence boundaries.
blocking_risk_zh: 关键词信号若被当成项目级技术应用或成本证据，会夸大减碳路径结论。
blocking_risk_en: Treating keyword signals as project-level technology adoption or cost evidence would overstate decarbonization-path conclusions.

implemented_en: The primary/secondary bubble chart exists; 306 companies enter the source-mix data and 161 companies have displayable primary/secondary ratios.

remaining_en: Only 13 companies use explicitly reported primary-data percentages. Most remaining ratios are method_rows source-mix inference and are not audited calculation weights.
current_evidence_zh: 当前有 306 家企业进入来源结构数据，161 家有可显示初级/次级比例，其中 13 家来自原文明示 primary data 百分比，其余为 method_rows 来源结构推断；中英文静态 PNG 已同步生成。来源审计 CSV 已列出 306 家企业；总分类队列 288 条，并拆成来源类别补回 145 条、unknown 占比复核 143 条、计算权重核验 161 条。
current_evidence_en: Current source-mix data covers 306 companies, with 161 displayable primary/secondary ratios. 13 use explicitly reported primary-data percentages, while the rest use method_rows source-mix inference; bilingual PNGs are generated. The source-mix audit CSV lists 306 companies; the total classification queue has 288 rows and is split into 145 source-origin backfills, 143 unknown-share reviews, and 161 calculation-weight validations.

blocking_risk_zh: 来源结构比例若被当成真实计算权重，会误导初级数据质量判断。
blocking_risk_en: Treating source-mix ratios as true calculation weights would mislead the primary-data quality assessment.
